_about: Will-o'-Wisp Race courses. Roll 1d6 + modifiers >= difficulty to clear a leg; fail = -1 Bearing; Bearing 0 = out.
_tags: _src lists source tags from sources.md; FILLER = invented in this package, replace freely

items.name: Lighthouse Race

legs.note: Light the stair. This is the last true bearing.
The hub that should have been the center. Do not hunt long.
A made ward. Cross only if the lattice still sings.
Keep the count. One missed gear & the wisp goes dark.
Do not skip the mountain. No Nightburr blight on this slope.
Rest is a trap here. Take water & leave.
Run the glade. Do not drink with the hosts. The blighted oak is a lie.
Jump or fall. The wisp does not wait.
The wound. Hold a shape or become weather. The Regent's shadow hides in the soup.

items.fail_text: The wisp has consumed the runner.
items.finish_text: The wisp holds at the Magpie Light. Run it again if the bearing slips.

items.name: Inner Ring Race

legs.note: Call the wisp. The mist is the starting gate.
Hold the heat. There is nothing to drink.
Stone that has not chosen yet. Keep moving.
Beast home. Do not hunt. You are a guest in the den.
Every step is a contract with mud.
No surface unless you make one. Do not invent a sky.
Para elemental cold. This is not the Rimeward.
No floor unless you make one. Think in three directions.
Find the curtain before the bank closes.

items.finish_text: The wisp is back in the mist. The ring is still turning.
